title: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.14.1 pair: regenerate the managed Quest block, regenerate lore artifacts, bump the CI lore pin
description:
Found by the Sunday estate audit on 2026-10-25 at about 06:32Z (01:32 local), CORRECTED from an earlier version of this record that said 2026-10-24, and approved by opum-doc as an owner task, tracked fleet-wide as OPAG-1521. Filed tracker-only on 2026-10-25; the fix waited for the day plan, which scheduled it the same day.

MEASURED on origin/dev 64f9f02 (2026-10-25): the CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares `Quest CLI 0.13.0`, and .github/workflows/ci.yml:70 pins `LORE_VERSION: 0.13.0`. npm publishes @opum-ai/lore 0.14.1 and @opum-ai/quest 0.14.1, and the workstation globals are 0.14.1 for both.

WHY BOTH PINS MUST MOVE: the Quest pin lives only in the managed block -- the Tracker CI job sed-reads `Quest CLI <version>` out of CLAUDE.md and installs that version -- so regenerating the block IS the Quest pin bump. The lore pin is the explicit LORE_VERSION constant in ci.yml.

SCOPE: routine managed-block regeneration (`quest agents --update-instructions --target claude`) plus the pin bump, the same shape as WCLI-71 (0.12.0 to 0.13.0). Generated bytes only, no hand edits inside or around the managed markers, and the carve-out means no operator ask is needed for them. Schema regeneration under 0.14.1 belongs here too: local `lore check` exited 6 with schema-drift on all 11 schemas before this change, which is the 0.14.1 export differing from the 0.13.0 export. Out of scope: the docs frontmatter lore/X.Y.Z provenance stamps, which are history rather than live pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml LORE_VERSION reads 0.14.1, and no live CI pin of @opum-ai/lore or LORE_VERSION still reads 0.13.0
The CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.14.1, every changed byte in it sits between the managed markers, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0
lore agents --check exits 0 under lore 0.14.1, and lore check --strict and lore validate --strict are green
The PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job installing lore 0.14.1 and the Tracker job installing Quest 0.14.1 read from the log version line

implementationNotes: Landed in opum-ai/ward-cli#168 on commit 4851911bfad99c30767190993c991c9432b239df, validated by CI run 40195908929: Check, Docs and Tracker integrity all completed success on that head. Docs job log carries LORE_VERSION: 0.14.1 on every step, including the install step, and its install equality guard passed (added 2 packages). Tracker job log carries "Declared Quest version: 0.14.1" and QUEST_VERSION: 0.14.1, with its equality guard passing (added 17 packages). Local gates at lore/quest 0.14.1 on the same tree: lore check --strict exit 0 (32 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 4 profiles read 0 over capacity), lore validate --strict exit 0 (32 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 4 skipped), quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exit 0, lore agents --check exit 0, node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs exit 0 (28 concepts, 4 profiles, 0 in no profile), bun run check exit 0 (772 pass / 0 fail), git diff --check clean. Schema drift is gone: lore check exited 6 with schema-drift on all 11 schemas before the lore schema export under 0.14.1, and 0 after. lore agents --check still reports absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and the disabled plugin -- unchanged by this task and scoped to WCLI-79, which lands next. Field-name sweep for @opum-ai/lore, @opum-ai/quest and LORE_VERSION found no live 0.13.0 pin outside .claude/worktrees/review-149-408161b, which is a DEC-208 review worktree at an old SHA and is not touched.

OPUS SECURITY REVIEW, DEC-182 (a1), recorded 2026-10-25T14:08:58Z (clock read). Review unit ward-cli-review-168 reviewed opum-ai/ward-cli#168 (this task) by ref at 2d8c04bab3c9a5bea36406d10ce914e047dc38f0, 16 of 16 turns on claude-opus-5-5. Verdict file read by this session and re-hashed at record time: sha256 57f4e32b50646b63079aee2459ce8570... matches the reported 57f4e32b50646b63. Verbatim from here, with nothing added or removed, through the final line of the file:

VERDICT: APPROVE. This is the Opus security review by ref of opum-ai/ward-cli#168 (WCLI-78) at 2d8c04b, under DEC-182 (a1).

VERDICT: APPROVE
SHA: 2d8c04bab3c9a5bea36406d10ce914e047dc38f0

SCOPE: I read all of .github/workflows/ci.yml (147 lines). I read .lore/schemas/adr.schema.json in full and the profileDigest line of all 11 .lore/schemas/*.schema.json files. I read CLAUDE.md, which is in my context: the managed Quest/lore blocks plus a scan of the hand-written profile for anything instruction-like that is out of place. I grepped package.json, bun.lock, bunfig.toml, .lore/config.toml and .quest/workspace.toml for lore/quest/opum-ai references and globbed for .npmrc and other workflows. ci.yml is the only workflow, the repository has no .npmrc, and lore and quest are not package dependencies, so #168 has no lockfile delta.

AUTHORING MODEL: You measured this from the writer's transcript a11d6a27-f485-4382-9467-a4480eab2ee3: argv --model deepseek-flash[1m], 637 assistant turns on deepseek-flash and none on Anthropic models. That is a breach of DEC-182 (1), because sensitive CI-pin work was authored on DeepSeek, and of (2), because the change merged with no Opus review. I cannot write to the tracker, so I have NOT recorded the breach on WCLI-78. The ward-cli writer or the leader still needs to record it on the task, citing that transcript.

ANSWERS TO THE QUESTIONS:
- How LORE_VERSION is used (ci.yml:70, 81-84): it is a literal 0.14.1 in the Docs job's env. It reaches the shell only as a quoted variable ("@opum-ai/lore@${LORE_VERSION}"), never through a ${{ }} expression inside run:, and nothing untrusted writes it. After installing, the step checks `lore --version` against the pin and fails on a mismatch. The package name is the fixed scoped literal @opum-ai/lore at an exact version, not a range.
- A second pin moved in the same change, which your diff list put out of scope. CLAUDE.md:4 "Quest CLI 0.14.1" is the Tracker job's Quest pin: ci.yml:119 reads it with sed. The capture only accepts `[0-9][0-9.]*` and takes the first match (head -1), and the value reaches `npm install --global "@opum-ai/quest@${QUEST_VERSION}"` through step env (ci.yml:127-131), not through expression interpolation. So PR-controlled CLAUDE.md text cannot inject anything beyond digits and dots, and the step also checks the installed version against it.
- Action pins: every action is pinned to a full 40-character commit SHA (checkout d23441a4 at :53/:72/:111, setup-bun 0c5077e5 at :54, setup-node 24997072 at :73/:112), and #168 changed none of them.
- Permissions, secrets and runner: unchanged. The top level is `permissions: contents: read` (:40-41), no job overrides it, and no secrets.* reference appears anywhere. Every job runs on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64]. Triggers are pull_request to dev and push to dev/main, with no pull_request_target.
- Schema delta: it does not loosen validation; it tightens it. Every schema's root has `additionalProperties: {}` (adr.schema.json:453), so a `decisions` key was already accepted with any value. The new property (adr.schema.json:76-88) narrows it to an array of strings or null and is not added to `required`. The new profileDigest sha256:997dc4f9…72a is identical across all 11 files.

FINDINGS:
1. ci.yml:72 and :111 (checkout, which leaves the token in .git/config) together with ci.yml:81 and :131 (the npm installs). Non-blocking, pre-existing, not introduced by #168, but it answers your "floating transitive install" question, so I am raising it as a finding for a new task rather than a passing note. `npm install --global` runs with no lockfile and without --ignore-scripts, so the transitive dependency ranges of @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest, and their lifecycle scripts, are resolved and run unpinned at CI time. These jobs hold no secrets, but neither the Docs nor the Tracker checkout sets `persist-credentials: false`. actions/checkout therefore leaves the job's GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config, where anything the npm install runs can read it. That token is contents:read on a private repository whose product is secret management. The step after each install only checks the top-level version, so it would not catch a compromised transitive dependency. Suggested fix, as a new ward-cli task: set `persist-credentials: false` on the Docs and Tracker checkouts, which only read the tree. If you want to go further, also consider `--ignore-scripts` on the global installs, or a shrinkwrap shipped by lore/quest. Whether those two are adoptable is a design question for opum-doc.

No other findings. I found nothing in the reviewed files outside the stated bump. The ci.yml change is the single LORE_VERSION line, and the schema change is limited to the digest plus the `decisions` property.

UNVERIFIED (a tree read cannot establish these):
- That your changed-file list for #168 is complete. I could not diff.
- That the other 10 schema bodies changed only in the digest. That rests on your gh pr diff; I confirmed only that the digest line is uniform.
- That CI ran green on 2d8c04b itself, and that the CLAUDE.md managed blocks are byte-exact generator output. `lore agents --check` and `quest agents --check` gate the generated bytes; hand-written lines are not gated, and my scan of them found nothing out of place.
- Registry provenance and integrity of @opum-ai/lore@0.14.1 and @opum-ai/quest@0.14.1, and whether either ships an npm-shrinkwrap.json.
- Whether the mbpm2 ephemeral runners carry a global .npmrc or a registry override.
- That sha256:997dc4f9… is the digest the 0.14.1 generator emits. You report it byte-identical across seven repositories, which is consistent with that but does not prove it.

END OF VERBATIM REVIEW.

BREACH, as ruled and recorded by the opum-agent leader on 2026-10-25: this change breached DEC-182 in BOTH halves. (1) It was AUTHORED ON DEEPSEEK -- argv --model deepseek-flash[1m], 637 assistant turns on deepseek-flash and none on an Anthropic model, measured from the writer transcript a11d6a27-f485-4382-9467-a4480eab2ee3; CI-pin and workflow work is inside DEC-182's sensitive set, so a writer at or above Sonnet was required and DeepSeek was not permitted. (2) It MERGED WITH NO OPUS REVIEW -- the review above arrived after the merge, at the leader's direction under DEC-182 (a1), and supplies an after-the-fact verdict rather than the gate DEC-182 requires. Both halves are recorded here rather than as one because either alone would have been a breach. The concession the review makes is that it found nothing wrong with the change itself: APPROVE, one pre-existing non-blocking finding, nothing introduced by #168.

THE REVIEW'S FINDING IS FILED, NOT FIXED: the persist-credentials and unpinned-transitive-install finding is its own task, with the DEC-182 (1) model floor recorded on it, and the --ignore-scripts / shrinkwrap half routed to opum-doc as a fleet-wide design question.
finalSummary: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.14.1 pair, delivered in opum-ai/ward-cli#168. Three generated changes and no hand edits: the managed Quest block regenerated 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1 by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude (one line inside the markers; the Tracker job derives its install from it, so the block is the Quest pin); .lore/schemas/ exported under lore 0.14.1, which adds decisions to the ADR schema and bumps every profileDigest and clears the schema-drift that made lore check exit 6 on all 11 schemas; and ci.yml LORE_VERSION 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1. The record audit date was also corrected to 2026-10-25 ~06:32Z in the same commit, per the orchestrator ruling. Verified on commit 4851911bfad99c30767190993c991c9432b239df by CI run 40195908929, green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job logged at LORE_VERSION 0.14.1 and the Tracker job logging Declared Quest version: 0.14.1. Local gates at 0.14.1: lore check --strict 0, lore validate --strict 0, quest agents --check 0, lore agents --check 0, check-lore-agent-sources 0, bun run check 0 (772 pass), git diff --check clean.
